text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You increased the weight... again, didn't 
you? And yet, you're not even out of 
breath...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... how are you able to do so much? I 
have a hard time increasing my workload...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: How rare, you asking me a question.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, Bubble-senpai's recent running has 
just been so amazing... How could I not be 
curious?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Then I'll teach you! Let's do it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's it, focus on your breathing...! 
Keep your back straight, and lower it 
slowly.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huff... huff... like this, right? I see, 
this looks like it'll help me swing my 
arms faster when running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I used to think training that 
wasn't running was a bit boring, but now 
it's gotten fun.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's fun when you can really feel the 
results. Having fun is super important, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding, I'm actually just 
parroting everything Trainer said, though.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I barely managed it the other day, but 
today it feels so light...!
choice_data_list:
This is a workout method I saw in the 
latest research paper...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You have quite the dedicated Trainer. 
Knowing you, Senpai, I just assumed you 
worked all this out on your own...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Their guidance is never wrong, after all.
